action:
After a standard system update you need to restart Apt-Cacher to make all
the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apt-Cacher did not properly handle encoded newline
characters in requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
perform HTTP response splitting attacks.
isummary: Apt-Cacher could be made to return specially crafted HTTP responses.

apt-cacher.description: Caching proxy server for Debian/Ubuntu software repositories

title: Apt-Cacher vulnerability
